narrative:
Deposit pricing is the single largest NII lever in a cutting cycle. VeloBank's PLN 71B deposit franchise runs a blended cumulative beta of about 38%, with savings & term deposits (58%) and public-sector balances (61%) the most rate-sensitive.

Peers have moved first. Top-10 Polish banks cut savings rates by ~60bp in the quarter while VeloBank lagged, creating room to lower pass-through without losing top-quartile positioning.

The open question is the PLN 22.1B migrated from Citi Handlowy. Retention is 94% against a 90% integration case, but these clients have not yet experienced a VeloBank rate cut. The optimizer therefore applies tighter outflow guardrails to ex-Citi segments.

signals.title: Polish Banks Deposit Pricing Survey
signals.excerpt: Average savings account rates at the top-10 Polish banks fell ~60bp over the quarter, faster than at challenger banks, as lenders defend NIM.

signals.title: Citi Handlowy Retail Integration Completed
signals.excerpt: Migration of the Citi Handlowy retail business completed on 15 June 2026: PLN 22.1B of deposits, PLN 6B of loans, PLN 8.9B AuM and ~1,600 employees now on VeloBank systems.

signals.title: NBP Monetary Policy Council — Rate Decision
signals.excerpt: The MPC lowered the reference rate and signalled further easing as CPI returns toward the 2.5% target. Market pricing implies a terminal rate near 3.50%.
